title: Lesson 1 Quiz: How Machines Learn From Data

questions.text: What does the term 'training data' refer to in machine learning?
options: The final rule the computer uses to make predictions
The set of examples shown to the computer so it can learn patterns
The method used to adjust the decision threshold
The predicted result for each new example
questions.explanation: Training data is the collection of examples provided to the computer for it to discover patterns.

questions.text: Features are the measurable characteristics that describe each example in the training data.
questions.explanation: Features such as employment length and guarantor status help the model distinguish between outcomes.
